description:
The United States says it has launched the second phase of President Donald Trump’s ceasefire plan for Gaza, outlining a shift towards demilitarisation, transitional governance and reconstruction.
Special envoy Steve Witkoff said phase two would create a technocratic Palestinian body, the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza, to oversee day-to-day affairs, alongside the disarmament of all unauthorised armed groups.
However, the announcement, made via social media, omitted key details, including any further Israeli troop withdrawals or guarantees on increased humanitarian aid.
Reuters reports the plan includes a 15-member technocratic council and a proposed international security force, an idea Hamas has previously rejected.
Aid agencies say Israel has yet to meet commitments made in phase one, with restrictions still blocking essential supplies such as tents and winter relief.
Hamas has not formally responded, but regional mediators including Egypt, Qatar and Turkey remai

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Iran’s judiciary said today that Iranian protesters need to be separated into three groups at the moment, says Foad Izadi, a professor at the University of Tehran.
“One group is the people who actually committed murder. The second group are people who burned mosques, burned shops. And the third group are people who just participated,” he told Al Jazeera, speaking from Iran’s capital. “And I think Iran’s judiciary is going to look at each case individually.”
He added, “All of these people will have attorneys, and one thing that I can tell you is that they want to make sure that the number of people who are killed is minimised as much as possible because they don’t want to give Trump an excuse to attack Iran again.”
Meanwhile, Trump’s threats of military intervention over the killing of protesters and their potential executions, as he has claimed, are likely.
“Iranians don’t believe him when he talks about human rights. They do believe him when he talks about attacking Iran,” said Izadi
title: Iran wants to avoid giving Trump excuse to attack again: Analysis
